aliasSourcing.note: Hindi/Tamil and romanised local names. basis "sourced" = the saved page under data/raw/crops states the name (sourceIds point at it). basis "common_unsourced" = widely used local name added without a saved source page in data/raw/crops or data/raw/iisr (no Devanagari or Tamil script occurs in those saved pages); the Alias contract has no unsourced kind, so these carry kind "local"/"transliteration" with empty sourceIds and are listed here. They support name resolution only and are not evidence for any agronomic claim. scripts/catalogue/build.ts regenerates this manifest and does not yet reproduce these entries.
